heading.title: Jurisdiction of the Criminal Courts in Inquiries and Trials

article.title: Ordinary place of inquiry and trial
article.content: Every offence shall ordinarily be inquired into and tried by a Court within whose local jurisdiction it was committed.
article.html:
197Ordinary place of inquiry and trial

Section 197 · Chapter XIV

Every offence shall ordinarily be inquired into and tried by a Court within whose local jurisdiction it was committed.
